sql: WITH up AS (SELECT DISTINCT device_id FROM marts.fct_device_daily WHERE firmware_changed AND event_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-01-07'), up2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT device_id FROM marts.fct_device_event WHERE event_code='FW_UPDATE' AND event_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-01-07'), up3 AS (SELECT DISTINCT device_id FROM marts.dim_device WHERE firmware_version='1.1.0' AND valid_from >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' AND valid_from < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-08') SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM up), (SELECT count(*) FROM up2), (SELECT count(*) FROM up3)

WITH up AS (SELECT device_id, CAST(valid_from AS DATE) AS upgrade_date FROM marts.dim_device WHERE firmware_version='1.1.0' AND valid_from >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' AND valid_from < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-08'), d AS (SELECT dd.*, CASE WHEN dd.event_date < up.upgrade_date THEN '1.0.0' WHEN dd.event_date > up.upgrade_date THEN '1.1.0' END AS phase FROM marts.fct_device_daily dd JOIN up USING (device_id) WHERE dd.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-01-07') SELECT phase, round(avg(lte_loss_pct),2) AS avg_lte_loss_pct, count(lte_loss_pct), count(DISTINCT device_id), count(*) FILTER (WHERE firmware_version<>phase) mism FROM d WHERE phase IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH up AS (SELECT device_id, CAST(valid_from AS DATE) AS upgrade_date FROM marts.dim_device WHERE firmware_version = '1.1.0' AND valid_from >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' AND valid_from < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-08'), d AS (SELECT dd.device_id, dd.lte_loss_pct, CASE WHEN dd.event_date < up.upgrade_date THEN '1.0.0' WHEN dd.event_date > up.upgrade_date THEN '1.1.0' END AS phase FROM marts.fct_device_daily dd JOIN up ON dd.device_id = up.device_id WHERE dd.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-01-07') SELECT phase AS firmware_version, round(avg(lte_loss_pct), 2) AS avg_daily_lte_loss_pct FROM d WHERE phase IS NOT NULL GROUP BY phase ORDER BY phase
